void_scar.name: Price of Contact — permanent Void Scar
void_scar.prompt: Describe your permanent Void Scar. Examples include a reflection that no longer appears, soundless footsteps, no shadow, warmth that cannot stay in your skin, a colour missing from your sight, a name ordinary divination cannot speak, tasteless food, or animals that fall silent when you approach. Ordinary healing or retraining cannot remove it. It is visible to Qi Sensing and to Secret perception and grants no extra concealment or immunity. Changing it needs a major story procedure using equal or higher Secret authority.
